messages.text: OMS is crawling again. Order acks taking 2-3 sec on anything over 5k shares. Anyone else seeing it?
Yeah, same. Sent a limit on a mid cap and the ack came back after the tape had already moved. Started around 14:40 for me.
Heard you both. Need timestamps and order ids for the slow ones so Tech can pull logs. Don't just tell me it feels slow.
Will dump a few. Also TradeBlotter P&L is lagging behind fills by like 10 sec, so it may be downstream of the same thing.
Fwiw I'm seeing PricingSvc quote refresh times spike in my latency monitor since about 14:35. OMS pulls prices from it, so that could be the root cause.
Agree with Sean. p99 on the pricing calls went from ~80ms to over 1.2s. OMS is probably queuing behind it. Blotter inherits it from both.
Good, that's useful. Sean, can you post the chart in #it-ops and tag Tech? I'll push on it from our side.
Risk here: if the pricing lag is real, RiskEngine intraday VaR is running on stale marks too. Desk, please be careful sizing into the close until we confirm it's clear.
Understood. Keeping clips small and working orders manually where I can until acks normalize.
Posted in #it-ops with the p99 chart and the window. Tagged the on-call SRE.
Ack times are back under 300ms as of 15:35, blotter caught up too. Will keep logging in case it comes back before the close.
